descriptionByLocale.it:
Posizione: Percentuale di lavoro di Zurigo: 80-100% per 6 mesi (con il potenziale di conversione in una posizione a tempo pieno) Data d'inizio: da settembre 2026 in poi Aiuta i nostri clienti a prendere decisioni di investimento o di immersione Avviare la tua carriera nel nostro team di Strategia & Transazione. Offriamo ai nostri clienti consigli su fusioni e acquisizioni, transazioni, valutazioni aziendali e ristrutturazioni. Siamo attualmente alla ricerca di un tirocinante per aderire al team Transaction Services. Unendo il nostro team è possibile supportare attivamente i clienti nell'analisi e nella valutazione delle informazioni per aiutarli a prendere decisioni e realizzare il valore aggiunto delle loro transazioni M&A come venditori e acquirenti. Il vostro lavoro influenzerà i prezzi e l'esecuzione delle transazioni M&A. Come si può fare un impatto
• Avrete l'opportunità di analizzare i bilanci, le relazioni aziendali e altre informazioni finanziarie su aziende di vari settori - da soli e in team
• È possibile contribuire attivamente alla redazione dei responsabili del cliente (Powerpoint e Excel) per dirigenti e decisori senior, con crescente responsabilità
• Potrai sfruttare gli strumenti AI abilitati per migliorare la profondità, l'efficienza e la qualità della tua analisi, aiutando il team a generare approfondimenti più nitidi
• Imparerai ad avere attenzione ai dettagli senza perdere di vista il grande quadro
• Avrete la possibilità di contribuire positivamente allo spirito di squadra con il vostro atteggiamento verso il basso verso la terra e la motivazione cielo-alto Chi stiamo cercando
• Motivazione al lavoro sotto pressione e con scadenze brevi
• Alla fine del Master in Finanza, Banca, Contabilità e/o MBA
• Gli stage precedenti (e/o l'esperienza lavorativa) in M&A, Investment Banking, Audit, Private Equity, Finance & Control ecc sono molto apprezzati.
• L'esperienza nei progetti di due diligence e/o l'analisi dei bilanci, dei flussi di cassa, dei rendimenti e delle forti competenze e delle esperienze eccellenti con la gestione di grandi set di dati finanziari (ad esempio utilizzando Alteryx) è un vantaggio
• Inglese e tedesco sono obbligatori. Qualsiasi altra lingua sarebbe un forte vantaggio Il nostro team di Transaction Services fornisce consigli per acquirenti e venditori che vanno da piccole e medie imprese, a grandi multinazionali e imprese private di equity nella loro valutazione di potenziali transazioni. Non vediamo l'ora di averti come parte della nostra squadra! Offriamo l'opportunità di imparare qualcosa di nuovo ogni giorno in un ambiente di supporto, bassa gerarchia e altamente collaborativo. Siamo un team di professionisti 40+ di vari paesi che contribuiscono ad aggiungere valore reale ai nostri clienti. La lingua ufficio è prevalentemente inglese e apprezziamo la diversità in tutte le sue forme. Vi aiuteremo a crescere come professionista tramite formazione, coaching e molte altre opportunità di sviluppo continuo. Carriere a Deloitte. Scegli il tuo impatto. A Deloitte, le tue idee creano impatto e scatenano cambiamenti significativi per i nostri clienti, persone e società. La vostra esperienza, background e prospettiva unica ci aiuta a trovare nuovi modi nelle sfide più complesse in modo da poter illuminare i futuri di quelli che il nostro lavoro colpisce. A Deloitte, puoi costruire una carriera che ti ispira e ti stimola. A Deloitte, puoi scegliere il tuo impatto. In Svizzera, forniamo servizi specifici per il settore nei settori Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. Con quasi 3.000 dipendenti in sei sedi, serviamo aziende e organizzazioni di tutte le dimensioni in tutti i settori industriali. Offriamo lavoro significativo e stimolante, un ambiente inclusivo e di supporto in cui si può essere il vostro migliore sé e dove non smetterete mai di crescere. Potrai beneficiare di condizioni di lavoro flessibili e ibridi, il benessere e i programmi genitoriali, così come molte opportunità per collegare, collaborare e imparare. Unisciti a noi e entra a far parte di una rete globale di persone affini dedicate a fare la differenza, sia affrontando il cambiamento climatico o migliorando 100 milioni di futures entro il 2030. Si prega di fare clic su “applica ora” per inviare una domanda completa, tra cui CV, lettera di copertura, riferimenti e certificati di laurea. Se hai domande, contatta Lucrezia all'indirizzo talent@deloitte.ch * Consideriamo tutti i candidati qualificati per l'occupazione indipendentemente da razza, etnia, credenze religiose, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, origine nazionale, età o disabilità, in conformità con la legge applicabile. descriptionByLocale.en:
Location : Zurich Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% for 6 months (with the potential to convert to a full-time position) Start date : from September 2026 onwards Help our clients making investment or divestment decisions Launch your career in our Strategy & Transaction team. We offer our clients advice on mergers & acquisitions, transactions, company valuations and restructuring. We are currently looking for a trainee to join the Transaction Services team. By joining our team you can actively support clients on analysing and assessing information to help them make decisions and realize the added value of their M&A transactions as sellers and buyers. Your work will impact the pricing and execution of M&A transactions. How you can make an impact
• You will have the opportunity to analyse financial statements, company reports and other financial information on companies from various sectors - on your own and in teams
• You can actively contribute to drafting client deliverables (Powerpoint and Excel) for senior executives and decision-makers, with increasing responsibility
• You will leverage AI-enabled tools to enhance the depth, efficiency and quality of your analysis, helping the team generate sharper insights
• You will learn to have attention to detail without losing sight of the big picture
• You will have the chance to positively contribute to the team spirit with your down-to-earth attitude and sky-high motivation Who we are looking for
• Motivation to work under pressure and with short deadlines
• Nearing the end of your Master’s degree in Finance, Banking, Accounting and/or MBA
• Previous internships (and/or work experience) in M&A, Investment Banking, Audit, Private Equity, Finance & Control etc. are highly appreciated
• Experience in due diligence projects and/or analysis of the balance sheets, cash flow, income statements and strong excel skills and experience with handling large financial datasets (e.g. using Alteryx) is an advantage
• English & German are mandatory. Any additional languages would be a strong advantage Your team Our Transaction Services team gives advice for buyers and sellers ranging from small and medium sized enterprises, to large multinational corporations and private equity firms in their evaluation of potential transactions. We look forward to having you as part of our team! We offer an opportunity to learn something new every day in a supportive, low-hierarchy and highly collaborative environment. We are a 40+ team of professionals from various countries helping to add real value to our clients. The office language is predominantly English and we appreciate diversity in all its forms. We will help you grow as a professional via training, coaching and many other continuous development opportunities. Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.apply.deloitte.ch How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on “apply now” to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Lucrezia at talent@deloitte.ch *We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; don’t hold yourself back – apply today. We do not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this position. © 2026. For information, contact Deloitte AG. All rights reserved. Location: Basel, Zurich, Geneva Work Pattern Percentage: 80% - 100% "Make an Impact that Matters" – join us and advise companies and individuals on Swiss and international tax matters related to senior executives, mobility and reward. Deploy your curiosity, learn, and continue growing into the trusted advisor for our clients. The world has changed – and so have the many rules that must consider. Our clients need fast, technically sound, and practical advice so they can move forward with their projects. We are involved right from the start and have the chance to support as well with the implementation of solutions, providing end-to-end multidisciplinary support. You work in international teams with clients from all over the world. We are solution-oriented and offer a flexible working environment that allows hybrid work. Fill your backpack with practical experience and knowledge from all over the world and develop your tax advisory skills every day with us. How you can make an impact
• You will join our dynamic tax advisory team and will deal with tax advisory projects in a wide range of areas: Swiss and international taxation of cross-border employment structures and planning, equity incentives, pensions, rulings, etc.
• You will have the opportunity to manage projects with the support of our leadership team from day one, to be involved in client-facing activities in projects in the field of individual taxes.
• You can participate and help shape solutions: we advise our clients ad hoc because the general information and easy solutions are already available on the Internet. For this, you will work with our national tax office to do research, write and prepare tailored advice.
• You can learn and apply your technical knowledge directly on fascinating cases. You help prepare and deliver presentations to clients and colleagues.
• Combine your strengths and skills with the know-how of our experienced teams – in this power combination you can develop your full professional and personal potential and help our clients in a wide range of individual tax topics. Who We Are Looking For
• You hold a bachelor's or master's degree from a university or university of applied sciences in business administration, law or a similar field.
• You have a minimum of 5 years of professional experience in providing tax advisory services to international clients.
• You are a team player who appreciates the daily contact with clients and colleagues in our network. You like to work independently, efficiently and question the "status quo".
• You enjoy writing, doing research, exploring options and help design solutions. You are eager to learn and willing to develop and would like to benefit from our tax trainings.
• You are outgoing and enjoy helping people solve their challenges and you also have a thirst for knowledge that will bring new perspective to our projects.
• You are able to manage tasks with competing deadlines and prioritise accordingly as well as like to work in teams and have experience in managing them.
• You speak German or French fluently and have very good English skills. Your Team Become part of a diverse, dynamic, and highly motivated team that is growing! We value teamwork, exchange of ideas and entrepreneurial thinking. Cohesion, trust and having fun together is part of our everyday cooperation as well as an open feedback culture. The team is based in all offices across Switzerland as we are working closely together with our colleagues from other teams and serve our clients across industries. Careers at Deloitte. Start your career as a consultant in our Tax & Legal team and advise our clients on solving complex local and global tax and trust issues. • You have a Master in Law or Economics or a Bachelor in Economics and are happy to bring your first tax experience.
• You are curious, open-minded and courageous, but at the same time always respectful and inclusive.
• You bring a positive, solution-oriented basic attitude as well as a willingness to take on responsibility, as well as a feeling for numbers and economic connections.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Offriamo con orgoglio:
• Un posto di lavoro sicuro con zero tolleranza per molestie.

Guidare la trasformazione digitale sicura per i nostri clienti Ci concentriamo sul consentire ai nostri clienti il viaggio di trasformazione digitale end-to-end con il nostro approccio Security by Design. A tal fine, ci si aspetta di sviluppare architetture sicure che supportano gli obiettivi aziendali e di sicurezza dei clienti, nonché di sviluppare approcci attuabili per l'adozione. Come si può fare un impatto
• Impegnarsi con il cliente per comprendere il paesaggio delle minacce client e i rischi informatici
• Sviluppare una sicurezza cloud, visione della sicurezza della rete, strategia, roadmap e principi di progettazione
• Leader team per sviluppare design di alto livello (HLD), design a basso livello (LLD) e l'implementazione di soluzioni di sicurezza definite nella strategia
• Assistere i client con l'adozione di moderne funzionalità di sicurezza cloud (ad esempio Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Cloud Workload Protection Platform (CWPP), Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB), sicuro CI/CD pipeline, sicurezza dei dati e conformità, o simili), e le capacità di infrastruttura di rete (ad esempio, Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), Software-Defined Wide Area Networks (SD-WAN), Software SD-Defined Perimeter Chi stiamo cercando
• L'utente ha almeno 5 anni di esperienza relativa nel ruolo di consulente tecnico, fornendo servizi professionali o consulenza interna nel campo della sicurezza.
• Possiedi buone capacità osservazionali e problem solving, così come la capacità di articolare concetti complessi in modo chiaro e conciso. Sei appassionato dei soggetti di Cybersecurity, Cloud, network e Zero Trust, e hai esperienza in diversi domini di sicurezza chiave.
• Hai un background educativo rilevante in Information Technology, Information Systems Security, Cybersecurity o un campo correlato. Possiedi una solida base attraverso lo stack di tecnologia Cybersecurity, tra cui l'infrastruttura cloud sicura in AWS, Azure, o GCP, le offerte di tecnologia leader di mercato, e l'esperienza con la rete aziendale, l'ingegneria della sicurezza (on-premises e Cloud), e i principi di Identity and Access Management. Avete esperienza utilizzando tecnologie di sicurezza come Cisco, Palo Alto, CrowdStrike, Zscaler e Netskope, o simili.
• Sarebbe vantaggioso avere certificazioni in Enterprise Security Architecture (ad esempio SABSA), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) e/o Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)

Location: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Are you passionate about technology and eager to drive strategic product vision? We're seeking a dynamic and proactive Product Owner with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize effectively. In this role, you'll define and shape our product roadmap, champion continuous improvement, and partner closely with engineering and business teams to deliver impactful solutions. You'll leverage the extensive knowledge and resources of a leading global organisation to innovate and drive operational excellence. Finding the talent that makes Deloitte unique As a Product Owner, you:
• are a tactical executor responsible for translating product strategy into actionable work items, managing the product backlog at sprint level, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality features.
• focus on sprint execution (2-week cycles), issue resolution, change request management, and operational excellence for multiple products.
• serve as the primary interface between the teams and product leadership, ensuring continuous delivery of value while maintaining system reliability and compliance with ITIL/ISO 2k service management standards.
• maintain strong technical engagement to understand implementation details, technical constraints, and quality standards while driving continuous improvement at the improvement and operational levels. How you can make an impact
• BACKLOG & PRIORITIZATION : Define and maintain the product backlog with clear, prioritized items aligned with product strategy - Write features and detailed acceptance criteria that enable to deliver quality work.
• Stakeholder Management: Prioritize features for sprint cycles based on business value, technical dependencies, and customer impact (shared with PM) - Manage technical debt prioritization to balance feature delivery.
• Incident & Problem Management: Lead incident response activities and coordinate resolution efforts - Assess severity and prioritize incidents based on business impact - Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) on critical incidents to prevent recurrence
• Team Collaboration & Governance: Run the daily standups to provide clarity, remove blockers, and track progress - Participate in sprint planning to align team capacity with product priorities and technical constraints
• Documentation: Product specifications are documented and maintained Who we are looking for
• Leadership/ Customer Focus: Customer issue resolution, feedback management, customer advocacy, usability assessment
• Technical Acumen : Understanding of software architecture, scalability, technical debt, API design, system integration - Deep and broad knowledge in the field of M365 and all related products.

• Issue & Change Management : ITIL change management, issue tracking, impact assessment, risk evaluation

Location: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% About the Opportunity We are looking for a dynamic, collaborative and results-driven Marketing Specialist for our Technology & Transformation consulting business. In this role, you will help shape and execute integrated marketing campaigns that strengthen the positioning of our consulting business in Switzerland and support our growth ambitions. Working closely with consulting leaders and subject matter experts, you will develop and deliver innovative, ROI-focused marketing initiatives that engage senior business audiences and address today's most pressing business topics, including Artificial Intelligence, digital transformation, sustainability and strategic technology alliances. You will partner with stakeholders across Switzerland, Europe and our global network to bring compelling go-to-market strategies to life, create meaningful client experiences, and continuously optimise campaign performance through data-driven insights. This role is based at our Zurich headquarters. How you can make an impact
• Lead the execution of key go-to-market campaigns for our Technology & Transformation consulting business, providing strategic marketing guidance, ensuring strong alignment with business priorities, and delivering measurable commercial impact
• Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels, leveraging the full marketing mix to drive awareness, engagement and business growth
• Create engaging content for digital marketing channels, including web, email, social media and thought leadership campaigns
• Coordinate online and in-person client engagement initiatives, including events, webinars, sponsorship activations and executive programmes
• Produce compelling client-facing marketing assets and sales enablement materials that effectively communicate our value proposition
• Support campaigns targeting senior executive audiences, including CEOs, Chief Technology Officers, Chief Strategy Officers, Chief Innovation Officers and other C-suite decision-makers
• Measure campaign performance, analyse ROI, client engagement and market trends, and translate insights into recommendations that continuously improve marketing effectiveness and differentiation
• Monitor competitor activity and emerging market trends to identify opportunities and strengthen our market positioning
• Collaborate with marketing colleagues across Switzerland, Europe and our global network to share best practices, leverage global assets and deliver consistent, high-quality campaigns Who we are looking for
• Relevant degree in marketing or related fields
• 3-5 years of marketing experience, of which ideally some in a professional services firm
• Proven track record in creating and executing integrated campaigns across all marketing channels and targeting a senior business audience
• Excellent project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment
• Strong writing and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex business topics into engaging marketing content
• Analytical mindset with experience measuring campaign performance and using data to optimise marketing effectiveness
• Experience with CRM, marketing automation and content management platforms (e.g. Salesforce, Marketo or similar tools) is an advantage.
• Fluency in English and German or French Why join us? This is an opportunity to work on some of today's most relevant business topics while partnering with senior leaders across our Consulting practice and international marketing network. If you enjoy combining creativity with data-driven marketing, thrive in a collaborative environment, and are passionate about creating impactful campaigns that drive business results, we'd love to hear from you. descriptionByLocale.it:
Posizione: Zurigo Svizzera Percentuale di lavoro: 80-100% Aiuta a trasformare le organizzazioni dei nostri clienti a sostenere la loro strategia aziendale Cosa facciamo? Il nostro team di Human Capital aiuta le organizzazioni a gestire e sostenere le loro prestazioni attraverso la loro risorsa più importante: la loro gente. Sfruttando la ricerca, l'analisi e le intuizioni del settore, supportiamo i clienti per progettare ed eseguire programmi critici dal business guidato HR a talenti innovativi, leadership, programmi organizzativi e di cambiamento nelle trasformazioni aziendali e tecnologiche. Siamo la più grande pratica del Capitale Umano nel mercato svizzero e siamo ampiamente riconosciuti dai nostri clienti per la nostra capacità di camminare nelle loro scarpe come un vero partner, portare la massima comprensione, competenza e fornire costantemente un lavoro di alta qualità. La natura del nostro lavoro varia notevolmente, ma le probabilità sono il vostro impegno coinvolgerà tutti i seguenti nel tempo: Recruitment, Compensation, Analytics, Performance Management, Talent & Succession Planning Management, Pensioni, Organizzazione Design, Strategia HR, HR Transformation, HR Technology & Adoption, Change Management, Comunicazione Strategiche e Culture Transformations, tutti finalizzati a massimizzare l'azionista e il valore del cliente. Come si può fare un impatto Siamo alla ricerca di una persona che ama affrontare le questioni di capitale umano di affari in modo analitico, che ha la pazienza di strutturare il processo decisionale, e che si sforza di sviluppare raccomandazioni pragmatiche, temperato dall'esperienza. La nostra aspirazione è aiutare i clienti a ottenere o mantenere un vantaggio competitivo contro un contesto di mercato in continua evoluzione. I nostri clienti ci apprezzano per la nostra capacità di vedere la visione attraverso la realtà, producendo un piano e un approccio per portare con successo la strategia di capitale umano del nostro cliente alla vita. Le vostre responsabilità di lavoro e come si può fare un impatto che conta. Lo farai:
• Lavorare direttamente con clienti svizzeri e internazionali in tutte le fasi del ciclo di vita di gestione dei cambiamenti organizzativi, dalla valutazione iniziale e dalla pianificazione della strategia di gestione dei cambiamenti organizzativi all'esecuzione, all'ipercare e all'adozione revisione con le giuste metriche.
• Introdurre e incorporare i migliori framework di gestione dei cambiamenti di prassi, governance, processi e strumenti per supportare le transizioni organizzative di successo e l'impegno degli stakeholder in tutte le fasi.
• Agire come membro del team chiave liaising con i leader dei clienti e gli stakeholder interni per allineare le iniziative di cambiamento con gli obiettivi aziendali e garantire una efficace comunicazione e collaborazione.
• Contribuisci agli sforzi di sviluppo aziendale di Deloitte e alla creazione di proposte collaborando con Human Capital, altre offerte di servizi Deloitte e alle squadre di account per progettare soluzioni di gestione dei cambiamenti convincenti.
• Sostenere la crescita e il miglioramento delle capacità di gestione dei cambiamenti di Deloitte e delle offerte di servizio all'interno della pratica del capitale umano. Chi stiamo cercando:
• Forte background accademico, idealmente un master o MBA da un'istituzione rispettabile, o equivalente esperienza professionale.
• Con un diploma di laurea, minimo 2-4 anni e con un master laurea/MBA minimo1 anno di esperienza rilevante in Consulenza o un ruolo simile all'interno del dominio Human Capital, preferibilmente con esposizione a progetti internazionali.
• Esperienza solida nella strategia delle persone e nella gestione dei cambiamenti, in particolare in contesti quali programmi di implementazione di grandi tecnologie e/o trasformazioni aziendali organizzative.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Location: Zurich Switzerland Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Help transform our clients’ organisations to support their business strategy What do we do? Our Human Capital team helps organizations manage and sustain their performance through their most important asset: their people. Leveraging research, analytics, and industry insights, we support clients to design and execute critical programs from business driven HR to innovative talent, leadership, organizational and change programs in business and technology transformations. We are the largest Human Capital practice in the Swiss market and are widely recognized by our clients for our ability to walk in their shoes as a true partner, bring leading insight, expertise and consistently deliver high quality work. The nature of our work varies greatly, but chances are your engagement will involve all of the following over time: Recruitment, Compensation, Analytics, Performance Management, Talent & Succession Planning Management, Pensions, Organisation Design, HR strategy, HR Transformation, HR Technology & Adoption, Change Management, Strategic Communications and Culture Transformations, all aiming to maximise shareholder and customer value. How you can make an impact We are looking for a person who enjoys addressing business human capital questions in an analytical manner, who has the patience to structure decision making, and who strives to develop pragmatic recommendations, tempered by experience. Our aspiration is to help clients to gain or maintain competitive advantage against an ever-changing market context. Our clients value us for our ability to see the vision through to reality, producing a plan and approach to successfully bring our client's human capital strategy to life. Your job responsibilities and how you can make an impact that matters. You will:
• Work directly with Swiss and international clients throughout all phases of the organizational change management lifecycle, from initial assessment and planning of the organizational change management strategy to execution, hypercare and adoption review with the right metrics.
• Introduce and embed best practice change management frameworks, governance, processes, and tools to support successful organizational transitions and stakeholder engagement at all stages.
• Act as a key team member liaising with client leaders and internal stakeholders to align change initiatives with business objectives and ensure effective communication and collaboration.
• Contribute to Deloitte’s business development efforts and proposal creation by partnering with Human Capital, other Deloitte service offerings, and account teams to design compelling change management solutions.
• Support the growth and enhancement of Deloitte’s change management capabilities and service offerings within the Human Capital practice. Who are we looking for:
• Strong academic background, ideally a Master’s degree or MBA from a reputable institution, or equivalent professional experience.
• With a bachelors degree, minimum 2-4 years and with a masters degree/MBA minimum1 year of relevant experience in Consulting or a similar role within the Human Capital domain, preferably with exposure to international projects.
• Solid experience in people strategy and change management, particularly in contexts such as large technology implementation programs and/or organizational business transformations.
• Experience contributing to client projects related to Learning & Development, Training & Re-skilling, with familiarity in ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft) and other system implementations (e.g., Salesforce, Workday, SuccessFactors).
• Strong affinity with technology and a deep understanding of its impact on the workforce, including how digital transformation shapes employee experience, skills requirements, and organizational change.
• Willingness and ability to support business development and offering enhancement initiatives.
• Demonstrated capability in managing stakeholder relationships strategically.
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with clients and internal teams.
• Positive, proactive attitude with a focus on delivering high-quality client service and contributing to team success.
• Fluency in written and spoken English and German is essential; proficiency in additional languages such as French is an advantage.
• Knowledge or experience in Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications in Human Capital or Change Management is a plus, including how AI can enhance employee engagement, learning, communication, and decision-making processes (is an advantage)
• Experience in Project Management and proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders or coordinating cross-functional teams in complex environments is a strong plus.
• Willingness to travel within Switzerland and internationally as required. Your Team Become part of a diverse, multinational and highly motivated team. We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes and on-the-job learning, but also by connecting with your colleagues across all business lines. Life at Deloitte At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on "apply now" to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Pieter-Jan at talent@deloitte.ch . *We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; don’t hold yourself back - apply today. We do not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this position. Deloitte AG and Deloitte Consulting AG are Swiss subsidiaries of Deloitte LLP, the DTTL member firm in the United Kingdom.

Unser Human Capital-Team hilft Unternehmen, ihre Leistung durch ihr wichtigstes Kapital zu verwalten und zu erhalten: ihre Mitarbeiter. Durch die Nutzung von Forschung, Analytik und Brancheneinblicken unterstützen wir Kunden bei der Gestaltung und Ausführung kritischer Programme, von geschäftsorientiertem Personal bis hin zu innovativen Talent-, Führungs-, Organisations- und Veränderungsprogrammen in Geschäfts- und Technologietransformationen. Wir sind die größte Human-Capital-Praxis auf dem Schweizer Markt und werden von unseren Kunden weithin für unsere Fähigkeit anerkannt, als echter Partner in ihren Schuhen zu gehen, führende Einblicke, Fachwissen und konstant qualitativ hochwertige Arbeit zu liefern. Die Art unserer Arbeit ist sehr unterschiedlich, aber die Chancen stehen gut, dass Ihr Engagement im Laufe der Zeit alle folgenden Aspekte umfasst: Rekrutierung, Vergütung, Analyse, Performance Management, Talent & Succession Planning Management, Pensionen, Organisationsdesign, HR-Strategie, HR-Transformation, HR-Technologie & Adoption, Change Management, strategische Kommunikation und Kulturtransformationen, die alle darauf abzielen, den Shareholder- und Kundenwert zu maximieren. Lieu: Zurich Suisse Profil de travail Pourcentage: 80-100% Aidez à transformer nos clients - les organisations pour soutenir leur stratégie d'affaires On fait quoi ? Notre équipe du capital humain aide les organisations à gérer et à maintenir leur rendement grâce à leur atout le plus important : leur personnel. En tirant parti de la recherche, de l'analyse et des perspectives de l'industrie, nous aidons nos clients à concevoir et à exécuter des programmes essentiels allant des RH axées sur l'entreprise aux programmes innovateurs en matière de talents, de leadership, d'organisation et de changement dans le domaine des transformations des affaires et de la technologie. Nous sommes la plus grande pratique du capital humain sur le marché suisse et sommes largement reconnus par nos clients pour notre capacité à marcher dans leurs chaussures en tant que véritable partenaire, apporter une perspicacité, une expertise et fournir constamment un travail de haute qualité. La nature de notre travail varie considérablement, mais les chances sont que votre engagement implique tous les éléments suivants au fil du temps: Recrutement, Rémunération, Analytique, Performance Management, Talent & Succession Planning Management, Pensions, Organisation Design, Stratégie RH, Transformation RH, Technologie RH & Adoption, Changement Management, Communications Stratégiques et Transformations Culturelles, tous visant à maximiser la valeur des actionnaires et des clients. Comment vous pouvez avoir un impact Nous recherchons une personne qui aime aborder les questions de capital humain des entreprises d'une manière analytique, qui a la patience de structurer la prise de décision et qui s'efforce d'élaborer des recommandations pragmatiques, tempérées par l'expérience. Notre ambition est d'aider les clients à obtenir ou à maintenir un avantage concurrentiel dans un contexte de marché en constante évolution. Nos clients nous apprécient pour notre capacité à voir la vision jusqu'à la réalité, en produisant un plan et une approche pour mener à bien la stratégie de capital humain de notre client. Vos responsabilités professionnelles et comment vous pouvez avoir un impact qui compte. Vous:
• Travailler directement avec des clients suisses et internationaux tout au long du cycle de vie de la gestion du changement organisationnel, depuis l'évaluation initiale et la planification de la stratégie de gestion du changement organisationnel jusqu'à l'exécution, l'hypersoins et l'examen de l'adoption avec les bonnes mesures.
• Introduire et intégrer les cadres de gestion du changement des pratiques exemplaires, la gouvernance, les processus et les outils pour appuyer les transitions organisationnelles réussies et l'engagement des intervenants à toutes les étapes.
• Agir en tant que membre clé de l'équipe en liaison avec les chefs de clientèle et les intervenants internes pour aligner les initiatives de changement sur les objectifs opérationnels et assurer une communication et une collaboration efficaces.
• Contribuer aux efforts de développement des affaires et à la création de propositions de Deloitte en partenariat avec le capital humain, d'autres services offerts par Deloitte et des équipes de comptes pour concevoir des solutions de gestion du changement convaincantes.
• Soutenir la croissance et l'amélioration des capacités de gestion du changement et des services offerts par Deloitte dans le cadre de la pratique du capital humain. Qui cherchons-nous?
• Forte expérience académique, idéalement un Master ou MBA d'un établissement réputé, ou une expérience professionnelle équivalente.
• Avec un baccalauréat, minimum 2-4 ans et avec un master/MBA minimum1 année d'expérience pertinente en conseil ou un rôle similaire dans le domaine du capital humain, de préférence avec une exposition à des projets internationaux.
• Une solide expérience en matière de stratégie des personnes et de gestion du changement, particulièrement dans des contextes comme les grands programmes de mise en oeuvre de la technologie et/ou les transformations organisationnelles.
• Expérience de la contribution à des projets clients liés à l'apprentissage et au perfectionnement, à la formation et au recyclage, à la connaissance des systèmes ERP (p. ex. SAP, Oracle, Microsoft) et à d'autres implémentations de systèmes (p. ex. Salesforce, Workday, SuccessFactors).
• Une forte affinité avec la technologie et une compréhension approfondie de son impact sur l'effectif, y compris la façon dont la transformation numérique façonne l'expérience des employés, les exigences en matière de compétences et le changement organisationnel.
• Volonté et capacité d'appuyer le développement des entreprises et d'offrir des initiatives d'amélioration.
• Capacité démontrée de gérer stratégiquement les relations avec les intervenants.
• Fortes aptitudes interpersonnelles et de communication, avec la capacité de s'engager efficacement avec les clients et les équipes internes.
• Une attitude positive et proactive qui met l'accent sur la prestation de services à la clientèle de haute qualité et contribue au succès de l'équipe.
• La maîtrise de l'anglais écrit et parlé et de l'allemand est essentielle; la maîtrise d'autres langues comme le français est un avantage.
• La connaissance ou l'expérience des applications de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) dans le capital humain ou la gestion du changement est un atout, y compris la façon dont l'IA peut améliorer l'engagement des employés, l'apprentissage, la communication et les processus décisionnels (est un avantage).
• L'expérience en gestion de projet et la capacité éprouvée de gérer plusieurs intervenants ou de coordonner des équipes interfonctionnelles dans des environnements complexes sont un plus fort.
• Volonté de voyager en Suisse et à l'étranger selon les besoins. Votre équipe Faites partie d'une équipe diversifiée, multinationale et très motivée. Nous vous aiderons à grandir personnellement et professionnellement : grâce à nos formations, à nos programmes de mentorat et à l'apprentissage en cours d'emploi, mais aussi en vous connectant avec vos collègues dans tous les secteurs d'activité. Vie chez Deloitte Chez Deloitte, vos idées créent un impact et un changement significatif pour nos clients, nos gens et notre société. Votre expertise, votre expérience et votre perspective uniques nous aident à trouver de nouvelles façons de relever les défis les plus complexes afin que nous puissions améliorer l'avenir de nos travaux. Chez Deloitte, vous pouvez construire une carrière qui vous inspire et vous anime. Chez Deloitte, vous pouvez choisir votre impact. En Suisse, nous fournissons des services spécifiques à l'industrie dans les domaines de l'audit et de l'assurance, de la fiscalité et du droit, de la stratégie, du conseil sur les risques et les transactions et de la technologie et de la transformation. Avec près de 3 000 employés sur six sites, nous servons des entreprises et des organisations de toutes tailles dans tous les secteurs de l'industrie. Nous offrons un travail significatif et stimulant, un environnement inclusif et solidaire où vous pouvez être votre meilleur soi et où vous n'arrêterez jamais de grandir. Vous bénéficierez de conditions de travail flexibles et hybrides, de programmes de bien-être et de programmes parentaux ainsi que de nombreuses possibilités de connexion, de collaboration et d'apprentissage. Rejoignez-nous et devenez membre d'un réseau mondial de personnes partageant les mêmes idées et vouées à faire la différence, que ce soit en s'attaquant au changement climatique ou en améliorant 100 millions d'avenir d'ici 2030. descriptionByLocale.en:
Location: Zürich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Help our clients successfully manage global challenges Launch your career as a Consultant in our Tax & Legal team you will advise demanding clients on complex taxation issues. Our Tax team offers a wide range of integrated tax services that help our clients to successfully manage local and global challenges. In this role, you will also advise national and international clients on leading strategies to simplify tax management and achieve global visibility for making informed strategic decisions. Be part of a team in which not only numbers are processed, but success is celebrated. How you can make an impact
• Get the opportunity to be involved in activities with client contact and be responsible for cross-divisional projects in various industries from the first day.
• Together with your team, advise our clients on complex tax issues, for example in the tax planning of a multinational company or in an M&A transaction.
• Develop a clear, long-term career path with internal and external professional training offers as well as the time and financial assistance necessary for the training to become a dipl. Tax expert or study the MAS FH in Swiss and International Taxation / LL.M. Swiss and International Taxation.
• Be part of an international and interdisciplinary team with plenty of learning on the job opportunities Who We Are Looking For
• You are curious and bold, respectful and integrative. You bring a positive and result-oriented attitude as well as the willingness to take over responsibility and find solutions for various clients.
• You have a flair for numbers and business connections as well as thirst for knowledge that enrich our projects with new perspectives.
• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s from a university or university of applied sciences degree in law, business administration or a similar field, ideally with tax knowledge.
• Experience in the tax field in as advantage
• You communicate confidently in German and English. Any further languages would be an advantage. Your Team Become part of a fun, highly motivated team of 30+ at our Zurich office. We don’t only like crunching numbers, but also enjoy spending time together as a team doing social events etc. We value teamwork and interdisciplinary work across all business lines. We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes and on-the-job learning. Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on "apply now" to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Lena at talent@deloitte.ch . *We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; don’t hold yourself back - apply today. We do not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this position. Deloitte AG and Deloitte Consulting AG are Swiss subsidiaries of Deloitte LLP, the DTTL member firm in the United Kingdom.

Join us and use your cyber expertise, entrepreneurial and innovative mindset to protect companies and society from digital threats, thus making the world a little safer. Help us as we support the next generation of cyber talent, invest in emerging technologies and drive progress in a dynamic, digital world. How you can make an impact

Nous offrons fièrement :
• Un lieu de travail sûr et une tolérance zéro pour le harcèlement.
• Des environnements ouverts où les gens sont libres d'être eux-mêmes.
• Une communauté inclusive qui croit au respect et au mérite. Lieu : Zurich Profil de travail Pourcentage : 80-100% Aidez nos clients à améliorer l'efficience et l'efficacité de leurs entreprises Rejoignez notre équipe d'amélioration et de restructuration des performances et jouez un rôle central dans la façon de façonner l'avenir des entreprises de nos clients. Collaborez étroitement avec les experts de Deloitte des services juridiques, fiscaux et réglementaires pour apporter des solutions sur mesure à nos clients. Nous nous engageons à entretenir et à développer vos compétences dès le premier jour, en vous assurant de rester à l'avant-garde de ce paysage dynamique. Comment faire un impact
• Soutenez notre équipe de base dévouée pour relever les défis de nos clients et répondre à leurs besoins grâce à des solutions pratiques. Il s'agit, par exemple, de l'amélioration de la performance, des analyses d'options stratégiques, des retraits gérés, des refinancements, des consolidations d'entités juridiques.
• Mener des recherches qualitatives et quantitatives et développer des idées. Ébauche des commentaires aux rapports des clients (p. ex., mises à jour de l'état d'avancement, options de restructuration) et préparation d'analyses financières, par exemple aux actionnaires, aux institutions de financement ou aux organismes de réglementation.
• Aider notre équipe à gérer les échéanciers, les coûts, les ressources et les produits livrables et être responsable du suivi.
• Soutenir la croissance de notre offre en contribuant à nos activités de développement des entreprises et à nos procédures de qualité/risque.
• Partagez vos idées, votre enthousiasme et vos idées d'investigation pour faire avancer nos projets et obtenir vos propres résultats. Qui nous cherchons
• Vous êtes un généraliste curieux avec une forte capacité d'écouter et d'expliquer des choses complexes d'une manière relatable et compréhensible. Vous aimez orchestrer le chemin vers une solution avec de nombreux contributeurs différents et élaborer des solutions pratiques.
• Vous avez une bonne compréhension des états financiers, êtes confiants dans le travail dans l'excellence et le point de pouvoir pour générer des idées significatives visant à permettre la prise de décisions dans des environnements à haute pression.
• Vous êtes ouvert d'esprit pour rejoindre notre voyage pour remodeler notre façon de travailler – l'IA fait partie de la façon dont nous faisons les choses.
• Vous avez les qualifications suivantes:
• Maîtrise ou près de l'achèvement d'un programme académique avancé avec un accent particulier sur la finance, la banque, l'administration des affaires, la comptabilité, l'économie ou le droit.
• 1+ ans d'expérience dans un domaine comme la stratégie, la transformation, les services de transaction, le conseil en gestion ou similaire (au niveau des consultants).
• Connaissance de la terminologie financière en allemand et en anglais. D'autres langues sont un plus, de préférence le français. Votre équipe Vivez notre environnement amical, collaboratif et international avec beaucoup de place pour vous connecter à d'autres personnes, grandir et être vous-même. Notre équipe travaille en collaboration au sein d'équipes interfonctionnelles composées d'un groupe diversifié de spécialistes de multiples disciplines, tant au sein de notre cabinet de consultation à l'échelle mondiale que de nos clients. Rejoignez notre équipe multiculturelle et croissante à notre bureau de Zurich. Nous offrons un rôle avec l'exposition à des clients mondiaux dans différentes industries et la possibilité de croître et d'apprendre sur le marché du travail, ainsi que avec nos programmes de formation Deloitte. Carrières chez Deloitte. Choisissez votre impact. Chez Deloitte, vos idées créent un impact et un changement significatif pour nos clients, nos gens et notre société. Votre expertise, votre expérience et votre perspective uniques nous aident à trouver de nouvelles façons de relever les défis les plus complexes afin que nous puissions améliorer l'avenir de nos travaux. Chez Deloitte, vous pouvez construire une carrière qui vous inspire et vous anime. Chez Deloitte, vous pouvez choisir votre impact. En Suisse, nous fournissons des services spécifiques à l'industrie dans les domaines de l'audit et de l'assurance, de la fiscalité et du droit, de la stratégie, du conseil sur les risques et les transactions et de la technologie et de la transformation. Avec près de 3 000 employés sur six sites, nous servons des entreprises et des organisations de toutes tailles dans tous les secteurs de l'industrie. Nous offrons un travail significatif et stimulant, un environnement inclusif et solidaire où vous pouvez être votre meilleur soi et où vous n'arrêterez jamais de grandir. Vous bénéficierez de conditions de travail flexibles et hybrides, de programmes de bien-être et de programmes parentaux ainsi que de nombreuses possibilités de connexion, de collaboration et d'apprentissage. Rejoignez-nous et devenez membre d'un réseau mondial de personnes partageant les mêmes idées et vouées à faire la différence, que ce soit en s'attaquant au changement climatique ou en améliorant 100 millions d'avenir d'ici 2030. descriptionByLocale.it:
Offriamo con orgoglio: un posto di lavoro sicuro con zero tolleranza per molestie. Ambienti aperti dove le persone sono libere di essere se stesse. Una comunità inclusiva che crede nel rispetto e nel merito. Percentuale: 80-100% Aiuta i nostri clienti a migliorare l'efficienza e l'efficacia delle loro aziende Unisciti al nostro team di Performance Improvement and Restructuring e gioca un ruolo fondamentale nella definizione del futuro delle aziende dei nostri clienti. Collabora a stretto contatto con gli esperti Deloitte di servizi legali, fiscali e normativi per portare soluzioni personalizzate ai nostri clienti. Siamo dedicati a nutrire e ampliare le vostre competenze dal primo giorno, assicurandovi di rimanere all'avanguardia di questo paesaggio dinamico. Come si può fare un impatto
• Sostenere il nostro team core dedicato a 'propri' le sfide dei nostri clienti' e per soddisfare le loro esigenze con soluzioni pratiche hands-on. Questi includono, ad esempio, il miglioramento delle prestazioni, analisi delle opzioni strategiche, uscite gestite, rifinanziamenti, consolidamenti delle entità legali.
• Condurre ricerca qualitativa e quantitativa e sviluppare approfondimenti. Progetto di input ai rapporti dei clienti (ad esempio aggiornamenti di stato, opzioni di ristrutturazione) e preparazione di analisi finanziarie, ad esempio agli azionisti, agli istituti di finanziamento o ai regolatori.
• Aiuta il nostro progetto di squadra a gestire le linee temporali, i costi, le risorse e i responsabili del monitoraggio.
• Sostenere la crescita della nostra offerta contribuendo alle nostre attività di sviluppo aziendale e procedure di qualità/rischio.
• Condividi le tue idee, l'entusiasmo e le tue intuizioni investigative per portare avanti i nostri progetti e possedere i tuoi prodotti. Chi stiamo cercando
• Sei un curioso generalista con una forte capacità di ascoltare e di spiegare questioni complesse in modo relabile e comprensibile. Ti piace orchestrare il percorso di una soluzione con molti diversi contributori e lavorare soluzioni pratiche.
• Avete una buona comprensione del bilancio, siete sicuri di lavorare in Excel e punto di potere per generare intuizioni significative finalizzate a consentire il processo decisionale in ambienti ad alta pressione.
• Siete di mentalità aperta per unire il nostro viaggio per rimodellare come lavoriamo – l'intelligenza artificiale è parte di come facciamo le cose.
• Hai le seguenti qualifiche:
• Laurea magistrale con particolare attenzione alla finanza, bancario, amministrazione aziendale, contabilità, economia o legge.
• 3+ anni di esperienza lavorativa in un settore come strategia, trasformazione, servizi di transazione, consulenza di gestione o simili (a livello di consulente).
• Fluenza in tedesco e inglese con conoscenza della terminologia finanziaria. Altre lingue sono un plus, preferibilmente francese. Il vostro Team Vivi il nostro ambiente amichevole, collaborativo e internazionale con un sacco di spazio per voi per connettersi ad altre persone, crescere ed essere te stesso. Il nostro team lavora in collaborazione all'interno di team interfunzionali che sono composti da un gruppo diversificato di specialisti in più discipline sia all'interno della nostra pratica di consulenza a livello globale che dai nostri clienti. Unisciti alla nostra crescente e multiculturale squadra nel nostro ufficio a Zurigo. Offriamo un ruolo con l'esposizione a clienti globali in diverse industrie e l'opportunità di crescere e imparare sia sul lavoro, così come con i nostri programmi di formazione Deloitte. Non vediamo l'ora di sentire da voi! Si prega di fare clic su “applica ora” per inviare una domanda completa, tra cui CV, lettera di copertura, riferimenti e certificati di laurea. Se hai domande, contatta Lucrezia all'indirizzo talent@deloitte.ch * Consideriamo tutti i candidati qualificati per l'occupazione indipendentemente da razza, etnia, credenze religiose, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, origine nazionale, età o disabilità, in conformità con la legge applicabile. La ricerca mostra che le donne sono meno propensi a candidarsi per i ruoli a meno che non corrispondano a tutti i criteri; non trattenetevi indietro – si applicano oggi. Non accettiamo domande da agenzie di reclutamento per questa posizione. We proudly offer: A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment. Open environments where people are free to be themselves. An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location : Zurich Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% Help our clients to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of their companies Join our Performance Improvement and Restructuring team and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our clients' businesses. Collaborate closely with Deloitte experts from legal, tax and regulatory services to bring tailored solutions to our clients. We are dedicated to nurturing and expanding your skills from day one, ensuring you stay at the forefront of this dynamic landscape. How you can make an impact
• Support our dedicated core team to 'own' our clients’ challenges and to meet their needs with practical hands-on solutions. These include e.g. performance improvement, strategic option analyses, managed exits, refinancings, legal entity consolidations.
• Conduct qualitative and quantitative research and develop insights. Draft input to client reports (e.g. status updates, restructuring options) and prepare financial analyses e.g. to shareholders, financing institutions or regulators.
• Help our team project manage timelines, cost, resources and deliverables and be responsible for tracking.
• Support the growth of our offering by contributing to our business development activities and quality/risk procedures.
• Share your ideas, enthusiasm, and investigative insights to drive our projects forward and own your own deliverables. Who We Are Looking For
• You are a curious generalist with a strong ability to listen and to explain complex matters in a relatable and understandable way. You enjoy orchestrating the path to a solution with many different contributors and working out practical solutions.
• You have a good understanding of financial statements, are confident in working in excel and power point to generate meaningful insights aimed at enabling decision-making in high-pressure environments.
• You are open-minded to join our journey to reshape how we work – AI is part of how we get things done.
• You have the following qualifications:
• Master’s degree with special focus on finance, banking, business administration, accounting, economics or law.
• 3+ years’ work experience in an area like strategy, transformation, transaction services, management consulting or similar (at consultant level).
• Fluency in German and English with knowledge of financial terminology. Other languages are a plus, preferably French. Your Team Experience our friendly, collaborative and international environment with plenty of room for you to connect to other people, grow and be yourself. Our team works collaboratively within cross-functional teams that are composed of a diverse group of specialists across multiple disciplines from both within our consulting practice globally and from our clients. Join our growing, multicultural team at our office in Zurich. We offer a role with exposure to global clients across different industries and the opportunity to grow and learn both on the job, as well as with our Deloitte training programs. How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on “apply now” to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Lucrezia at talent@deloitte.ch *We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; don’t hold yourself back – apply today. We do not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this position. Prêt à plonger dans la technologie de pointe et faire une vraie différence pour les clients mondiaux? Chez Deloitte, nous recherchons des consultants dynamiques, curieux et motivés en planification de la chaîne d'approvisionnement qui veulent développer leur expertise tout en travaillant sur des défis passionnants et réels. Comment faire un impact
• Développer une connaissance fonctionnelle et conceptuelle approfondie de la planification de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, de la planification des ventes et des opérations à la prévision de la demande et au-delà.
• Conduire des solutions innovantes et technologiques qui transforment la façon dont nos clients planifient, produisent et fournissent.
• Aider les clients à mettre en place des processus, des capacités et une gouvernance solides, ou les guider au moyen d'évaluations, de sélections et de mises en oeuvre de systèmes de planification avancés (SPA).
• Conseiller les organisations de toutes tailles sur la planification des capacités, les stratégies de lancement de produits, la gestion des matériaux et les dernières technologies habilitantes.
• Préparer des rapports, des propositions et de la documentation pour appuyer les engagements des clients et la croissance des entreprises.
• Posséder vos projets avec autonomie, en collaborant étroitement avec de petites équipes agiles.
• Choisissez votre passion: plongez dans un sujet qui vous excite et développez-le par la recherche, un point de vue (PoV), ou même un engagement client.
• Collaborer régulièrement avec l'équipe de planification de la chaîne d'approvisionnement de Deloitte afin de réfléchir aux solutions et de développer des idées pour les projets en cours et le développement des entreprises.
• Faites l'expérience d'un mélange dynamique de travail avec des collègues de nos bureaux et de passer du temps sur place avec des clients — des QG aux usines — pour vraiment comprendre leurs défis. Qui nous cherchons
• Un passionné de conseil en gestion avec un Master en gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, en génie de la production industrielle, ou un domaine connexe.
• Expérience des disciplines de planification de la chaîne d'approvisionnement comme la planification intégrée des activités, l'optimisation des stocks, la conception de réseaux et le calendrier de production.
• Connaissance de la gestion des matériaux, de la planification du lancement des produits et de la gestion des coupes.
• Toute exposition antérieure à l'APS (Advanced Planning System) est un actif, qu'il s'agisse d'un utilisateur final, d'un consultant en implémentation ou d'un spécialiste des produits.
• Indépendant, proactif et prêt à prendre en charge des projets où vous pouvez briller comme une ressource clé.
• Un joueur d'équipe avec une curiosité intellectuelle et une faim d'apprendre continuellement.
• Travail confortable dans un environnement international, y compris les voyages à l'étranger au besoin.
• En anglais. D'autres langues, comme le français ou l'allemand, sont un fort bonus.
• Certifié ou travaillant vers des certifications comme APICS ou d'autres titres de la chaîne d'approvisionnement/opérations est un plus. Votre équipe
• Une équipe dynamique et solidaire qui est bien connectée à travers l'EMEA et le monde.
• Exposition aux projets de transformation de la chaîne d'approvisionnement de bout en bout — de la stratégie et de la conception à la mise en œuvre pratique.
• Possibilités de travailler avec des clients multinationaux dans diverses industries, notamment les entreprises de consommation, les sciences de la vie, les produits pharmaceutiques, les produits chimiques et la fabrication industrielle.
• Accès à de vastes programmes de formation internes et externes pour renforcer vos compétences et votre carrière.
• La liberté d'explorer et de développer vos propres idées à travers des projets de recherche, de PoV ou de client – votre croissance est entre vos mains.
• Possibilités de progression professionnelle alignées sur vos ambitions et vos intérêts.
• Un environnement favorable où vos commentaires sont entendus, vos idées sont prises au sérieux et votre croissance est encouragée. Carrières chez Deloitte. Choisissez votre impact.
